Peti
 Versus
 1. State Of Bihar
 2. Rahat Tabassum wife of Shahid Eqbal alias Afatabi and daughter of Jamal
 Akhtar resident of Village - Aarhaa, P.S. - Chandradeep, District - Jam
 present Mohalla - Takia Nawada, P.S. and District - Nawada.

For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Sanjesh Kumar Singh  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Ram Priya Saran Singh  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA  ORAL ORDER 2 09-11-2023 1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. Issue notice to the Opposite Party No. 2 by both modes i.e. registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary post for which requisites etc. must be filed on or before 30.11.2023 failing which the present quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
3. Put up this case on 29.02.2024.
4.

In the meantime, the order dated 28.09.2015 passed by the learned ACJM-III, Nawada in Complaint Case No. 1915 of 2014 whereby cognizance of offences under Section 498A of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.46942 of 2017(2) dt.09-11-2023 the IPC read with Section 4 of D.P. Act has been taken, shall remain stayed.
